## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem it solves

What user need or pain point does this address? Why would someone want this?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you imagine this working. Include rough UI or interaction notes if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Have you thought of other ways to solve the same problem? Why do you prefer this approach?

## Files likely involved

Which existing HTML, CSS, or JS files would need to change?

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar implementations, or any other relevant information.
